name: terminal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys,subprocess
L=Path.cwd();after=json.loads((L/'frozen-after.json').read_text());assert after['mismatches']==[]
exclusions={'MANIFEST.json':'Manifest cannot include its own hash without circularity.','terminal_manifest.receipt.json':'This invocation receipt is generated only after this terminal child exits; precisely named noncircular terminal exclusion.','terminal_manifest.output.txt':'This invocation output is written only after this terminal child exits; precisely named noncircular terminal exclusion.'}
files=[]
for p in sorted(L.rglob('*')):
 if not p.is_file():continue
 rel=str(p.relative_to(L))
 if rel in exclusions:continue
 b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
receipts=[x['path'] for x in files if x['path'].endswith('.receipt.json')]
assert 'get_mpr.receipt.json' in receipts and 'audit_inventory.receipt.json' in receipts
manifest={'scope':'All actual own-lane files present before terminal receipt/output generation; no peer access','algorithm':'SHA256','files':files,'included_completed_receipt_JSONs':receipts,'terminal_noncircular_exclusions':exclusions,'frozen_after':'13checked, zero mismatches; standalone outcome frozen-after.json included','qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0,'self_check':'Each listed hash computed from actual bytes, not placeholders; all completed prior receipts included. No frozen input written after final check.'}
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.json'],input=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
print(json.dumps({'manifest_files':len(files),'completed_receipts_included':len(receipts),'frozen_bindings':13,'mismatches':0,'qualified_survivors':0,'credit':0,'terminal_exclusions':list(exclusions)}))
